sources.title: Building a real-time AI RPG with evolving narratives using LLMs
sources.snippet: I've been working on an AI-powered RPG where the story evolves in real-time based on player choices. The goal was to combine traditional RPG mechanics (HP, XP, inventory, progression) with dynamic LLM-generated narratives. sources.title: GLM (AI) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: GLM, short for General Language Model, is a series of open weight large language models developed by Chinese software company Z.ai. Though the first GLM model was published on 3 March 2021, it was released under the name ChatGLM as an AI -based chatbot in March 2023.
